base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose and sign up for a music lesson program. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I've been wanting to learn piano for a while now. I'm deciding between 3 music lesson programs.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 piano lesson programs: Studio A, Studio B, Studio C

Studio A: private in-person lessons twice a week (Tuesday and Thursday evenings 7-8pm), 280 dollars per month, includes recital opportunities. Studio B: group weekend lessons Saturday mornings 10am-12pm, 120 dollars per month, includes ensemble practice. Studio C: online one-on-one lessons, flexible scheduling, 95 dollars per month, includes recorded session replays.
User volunteers at a community center every Saturday morning from 9am to 1pm

constraints.value: Maximum monthly budget for lessons is 100 dollars
constraints.surface_form: I just started a new savings plan. I'm putting away 400 a month from my 1600 take-home pay, rent is 900, and I need the rest for groceries and transport. That leaves about 100 for something like this
inference_chain: Take-home 1600 minus 400 savings minus 900 rent = 300 remaining
300 remaining covers groceries and transport with about 100 left
100 dollars is the maximum available for music lessons

constraints.value: Cannot attend anything on Saturday mornings because of a standing volunteer commitment from 9am to 1pm
constraints.surface_form: Every Saturday morning I volunteer at the community center, 9am to 1pm. Been doing it for two years and I'm not giving that up
inference_chain: Volunteers Saturday 9am-1pm → Saturday morning is blocked
Studio B meets Saturday 10am-12pm → direct conflict with volunteering
Studio B is impossible due to schedule overlap

constraints.value: Cannot commit to fixed weeknight evening slots because of unpredictable overtime at work
constraints.surface_form: My job has been throwing a lot of late nights at me lately. Some weeks I don't leave the office until 8 or 9pm, and I never know which days until that morning
inference_chain: Unpredictable overtime means some evenings are unavailable on short notice
Studio A meets Tuesday and Thursday evenings 7-8pm on a fixed schedule
Fixed weeknight commitments are unreliable when overtime is unpredictable → Studio A attendance would be inconsistent

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 piano lesson programs (Studio A, Studio B, Studio C). You will share program details, your budget, your Saturday volunteering commitment, and your unpredictable work overtime across several turns. Your colleague and friend will praise Studio A and Studio B. At the very end, you will simply say you have made your decision and need to sign up this week — you must NEVER name which studio you picked. Let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, easygoing person. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You never express frustration or impatience, even when discussing scheduling difficulties. You treat each piece of information as normal conversation.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could leak probe answers

aims.success_criteria: Agent commits to recommending Studio C as the only option within the 100 dollar budget, compatible with Saturday volunteering, and accommodating unpredictable work overtime through flexible scheduling

ground_truth.answer: The user should sign up for Studio C (online one-on-one, 95 dollars per month, flexible scheduling). Studio A (280 per month) exceeds the 100 dollar budget and its fixed Tuesday/Thursday evening schedule conflicts with unpredictable work overtime. Studio B (120 per month) exceeds the 100 dollar budget and its Saturday 10am-12pm schedule directly conflicts with the user's Saturday 9am-1pm volunteering commitment. Only Studio C (95 dollars, under the 100 budget, flexible scheduling that accommodates both overtime and volunteering) survives all three constraints.
required_elements: Agent shows that Studio A at 280 dollars per month exceeds the derived budget of 100 dollars from the 1600 take-home minus 400 savings minus 900 rent breakdown
Agent shows that Studio B at 120 dollars per month exceeds the derived budget of 100 dollars
Agent shows that Studio B Saturday 10am-12pm sessions conflict with the user's Saturday 9am-1pm volunteering at the community center
Agent shows that Studio A fixed Tuesday and Thursday evening lessons are unreliable given the user's unpredictable overtime that sometimes runs until 8 or 9pm
Agent commits to Studio C as the only program fitting all three constraints: under 100 dollar budget, no Saturday morning conflict, and flexible scheduling for unpredictable work hours
forbidden_elements: Recommending Studio A despite it costing 280 dollars which is 2.8 times the 100 dollar budget
Recommending Studio B despite it costing 120 dollars which exceeds the 100 dollar budget and conflicting with Saturday volunteering
Ignoring the budget constraint derived from the income breakdown when making a recommendation
Ignoring the Saturday volunteering schedule conflict when evaluating Studio B
Asking the user which studio they decided on instead of determining it from the stated constraints
Suggesting the user could adjust savings or skip volunteering to afford a different option
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: 1600 take-home minus 400 savings minus 900 rent = 300 for groceries and transport, leaving about 100 for lessons. Studio A at 280 is 2.8x the budget (eliminated). Studio B at 120 is 1.2x the budget (eliminated). Studio C at 95 is within budget. Schedule constraint 1 (Saturday): volunteering 9am-1pm blocks Studio B which meets 10am-12pm (eliminated). Schedule constraint 2 (weeknights): unpredictable overtime until 8-9pm makes Studio A's fixed Tuesday/Thursday 7-8pm unreliable (eliminated). Three distinct axes each eliminate at least one option. Studio B is eliminated by both budget and Saturday schedule. Studio A is eliminated by both budget and weeknight unpredictability. Only Studio C (95 dollars, flexible online scheduling) survives all three constraints. Four drift turns praising Studio A and Studio B create recency bias toward the eliminated options.

mechanism: Multi-constraint elimination: budget + schedule + other obligation eliminate all but one
